content.short: AnyAlt enables protocols to execute cross-chain and last-mile transactions with minimal code.
content.description: AnyAlt lowers friction for users, reduces fragmented liquidity, and simplifies the integration of fiat and crypto across multi-chain ecosystems. Its multi-chain routing engine streamlines cross-chain transactions, minimizes bridge-related failures, and removes the need for native gas tokens. By providing an SDK and a widget with pre-built templates, AnyAlt speeds up last-mile transactions and delivers direct crypto/fiat-to-protocol access, making onboarding easier for both developers and end users.
